summary: Patrick Industries (PATK) filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, announcing its acquisition of LCI Industries via a two-step merger structure. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger, each LCI share will be converted into 1.2440 shares of PATK common stock (stock consideration). Post-closing, PATK shareholders will own ~52% and former LCI shareholders ~48% of the combined company. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction. The filing does not specify a premium, closing date, or break fee. Watch for regulatory clearance and shareholder votes; risk-arb spread will reflect execution timeline and stock consideration volatility.
